text: A boar's ejaculate volume is 200–500 ml, creamy white in color, with ejaculation lasting 5–20 minutes. Sperm develop best at 37.5°C, which is why the testicles sit outside the body for a cooler temperature. Sperm takes 4 weeks to develop in the testicles plus 2 more weeks to mature in the epididymis, and remains viable inside the sow for 30–48 hours. Sperm quality depends on concentration (up to 100 million/ml) and motility, both checkable with a microscope. Climate, feed, stress, and sickness can all reduce sperm quality.
